subject: planner: constant propagation can deal with anti semi join (#62539)
summary: Renames/extends outer-join constant propagation to `expression.PropConstOverSpecialJoin` and enables it for `AntiSemiJoin` predicate pushdown so outer-side constant equalities can be substituted into anti-semi join ON conditions (allowing safe right-side filters like `t3.k=1` to be derived/pushed). Checked null-aware `IN/NOT IN` safety: `IsEQCondFromIn` equalities remain pinned to `OtherConditions` and `ColumnSubstitute` preserves `InOperand` on remaining columns, preventing unsafe pushdown/derived `IS NOT NULL` for null-sensitive cases.
